description: Determine if 24-hour cumulative rainfall exceeds threshold for on-chain trigger

steps.action: Fetch rainfall data from ≥2 independent meteorological sources
Calculate 24h cumulative rainfall from each source
Check source divergence: |max - min| / avg < max_source_divergence_pct
If divergence check PASSES: compute average. If FAILS: abort (NO_TRIGGER)
Compare average to threshold_mm. If avg > threshold → TRIGGER. Else → NO_TRIGGER

verification_checklist: All sources are in allowed_sources list
Timestamps are within acceptable window (not stale)
